name: Maya Thompson
description: A college student who relies on her car to commute to class and work.

issue.description: Low system voltage detected and the battery fails to hold a charge.

technician_diagnosis.confirmed_diagnosis: The 12-volt battery has failed and cannot hold a charge.
technician_diagnosis.technician_findings: The charging system passed testing, and there is no evidence of neglect.

name: Priya Shah
description: A hospital nurse who needs reliable transportation for early and overnight shifts.

issue.description: The passenger door has a cosmetic scratch that needs paint repair.

technician_diagnosis.confirmed_diagnosis: The passenger door has minor clear-coat and paint damage with no structural damage.
technician_diagnosis.technician_findings: The damage is cosmetic and limited to the passenger-door finish.

name: Jordan Lee
description: A delivery driver whose vehicle is used throughout the day for work.

issue.description: The tire-pressure monitoring system reports critically low pressure in one tire.

technician_diagnosis.confirmed_diagnosis: A road-hazard puncture damaged the tire beyond safe repair.
technician_diagnosis.technician_findings: The remaining tires have serviceable tread, and there is no evidence of neglect.

name: Marcus Green
description: A parent and daily commuter who frequently drives on highways with his family.

issue.description: The supplemental restraint system recorded a front-impact event and reports an airbag fault.

technician_diagnosis.confirmed_diagnosis: The front-impact event damaged SRS components that require replacement and calibration.
technician_diagnosis.technician_findings: The damage resulted from the collision, with no evidence of neglect or prior tampering.

name: Alex Rivera
description: A small-business owner who uses the vehicle for client visits across the city.

issue.description: The powertrain control module detected an incorrect transmission gear ratio while shifting.

technician_diagnosis.confirmed_diagnosis: The CVT has an internal mechanical failure and requires replacement.
technician_diagnosis.technician_findings: There is no evidence of neglect, fluid contamination, or missed maintenance.

name: Elena Brooks
description: A remote worker who mainly uses her car for errands and weekend trips.

issue.description: The oil-life monitoring system reports that an engine oil change is due.

technician_diagnosis.confirmed_diagnosis: The vehicle is due for a routine engine oil and filter change.
technician_diagnosis.technician_findings: No oil leak or engine fault was found; this is scheduled maintenance.
